actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined immune-activated identity with large effect sizes (|SMD|>1) and strong FDR control, supported by a significant BAP1 mutation enrichment and consistent CNV changes (chr20q gain, CDKN2A loss). Measured technical factors do not provide a dominant alternative explanation (all global q>0.05), and the structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0001 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent RNA-defined metabolic-enriched, immune-low identity with large effect sizes and strong FDR control, supported by significant BAP1 mutation depletion and mirror-image CNV changes. Measured technical factors do not provide a dominant alternative explanation (all global q>0.05), and the structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0002 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.
